title: MCP Reference: sheetsmcp.googleapis.com  |  Google Sheets  |  Google for Developers

facts.fact: The Sheets MCP server (sheetsmcp.googleapis.com) is in Developer Preview as part of the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program, which grants early access to certain features.
facts.quote: Available as part of the [Google Workspace Developer Preview Program](https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview), which grants early access to certain features.

facts.fact: The page defines an MCP server as a proxy between an external service that provides context, data, or capabilities and a Large Language Model or AI application.
facts.quote: acts as a proxy between an external service that provides context, data, or capabilities to a Large Language Model (LLM) or AI application.

facts.fact: The get_values tool returns a range of values from a spreadsheet and corresponds to spreadsheets.values.get in the REST API.
facts.quote: Returns a range of values from a spreadsheet.

facts.fact: The get_values tool's range parameter is required and accepts A1 or R1C1 notation, for example "Sheet1!A1:B10".
facts.quote: The A1 notation or R1C1 notation of the range to retrieve values from

facts.fact: The get_spreadsheet tool's include_grid_data parameter defaults to false.
facts.quote: True if grid data should be returned. Defaults to false.

facts.fact: The get_spreadsheet tool's comments_included parameter defaults to false.
facts.quote: If true, comments will be included in the response. Defaults to false.

facts.fact: The get_spreadsheet tool returns titles, sheet names, grid properties, and other metadata for a given spreadsheet ID, and full grid data if requested.
facts.quote: Returns titles, sheet names, grid properties, and other metadata for the given spreadsheet ID.

facts.fact: If no ranges are specified in get_spreadsheet, the entire spreadsheet is returned.
facts.quote: If not specified, the entire spreadsheet is returned.

facts.fact: The update_spreadsheet tool applies one or more updates to a spreadsheet and corresponds to spreadsheets.batchUpdate in the REST API.
facts.quote: Applies one or more updates to the spreadsheet.

facts.fact: The update_spreadsheet tool supports an updateSpreadsheetProperties operation for updating the spreadsheet's title, locale, and time zone.
The update_spreadsheet tool's updateDimensionProperties operation updates dimension properties such as row height or column width.
facts.quote: Updates dimensions' properties (e.g. row height or column width).

facts.fact: The update_spreadsheet tool's repeatCell operation repeats a single cell across a range.
facts.quote: Repeats a single cell across a range.

facts.fact: The update_spreadsheet tool's addNamedRange operation adds a named range, and namedRangeId is optional for it.
The update_spreadsheet tool's deleteNamedRange operation deletes a named range by its ID.
facts.quote: Deletes a named range by its ID.

facts.fact: The update_spreadsheet tool's addSheet operation adds a sheet to the spreadsheet.
